text:
maria: Morning! Weekend poll — thinking of a short microadventure on Sunday. beach walk + picnic 🏖️, quick mountain hike 🥾, or full couch-sourdough experiment 🍞? Vote with :beach:, :mountain:, or :couch: (or just say what you're up to)

 derek: Beach sounds great but I'm heading camping with the fam, gonna be off-grid. Tents + star gaze ✨

 sunita: I'm doing the farmers market + 5k parkrun in the AM, then yoga. If anyone wants to join for coffee after, ping me ☕

 jamal: Road trip to Twin Falls — leaving 6am, open to extra passenger if @maria wants a scenic detour. playlist curation in progress 🎶

 rachel: Hosting a "ramen remix" cooking night. Rules: 1 base broth, 3 wild toppings. Winner gets bragging rights. Anyone want to be a judge? 🏆

 maria: Ooh Twin Falls sounds fun jamal, but I might do beach + sourdough experiment. Here's my 'starter rescue' plan:
```
7:30am - feed starter
10:00am - mix dough
13:00pm - bench rest
16:00pm - preheat + bake
```
Anyone want a loaf? I'll bring slices to engineering on Monday :bread:

 ops-bot: Reminder: office pantry closed Sunday for maintenance — no coffee machines.

 derek: Bummer re: coffee. I'll bring some cold brew back Monday :cold_sweat:

 sunita: Quick poll suggestion: react with :beach: for beach, :mountain: for hike, :house: for staying in. I'll tally at 4pm.

 jamal: :mountain: :mountain: (for the falls)

 rachel: :house:

 maria: :beach:

 sunita: :beach:

 derek: (no reaction, camping)

 maria: OK looks like beach + one judge for ramen? @rachel I'll volunteer if I survive the sourdough.

 rachel: Perfect. Bring slices Monday and I'll bring scorecards 😂

 jamal: Safe travels everyone. Pics or it didn't happen 📸

 maria: Will post sunrise photo if the tide behaves.

 sunita: Have a great weekend folks! :sun_with_face:
